mapper.select: select gsr.id, gsr.send_id, gsr.schedule_date, gsr.entrust_mix_area, gsr.entrusted_mix_area, gsr.glue, gsr.send_qty, gsr.receive_qty, gsr.machine_code, gsr.recipe_type, gsr.recipe_version_id, gsr.recipe_stage, gsr.expect_demand_time, gsr.receive_status, gsr.receive_time, gsr.receive_person, gsr.source, gsr.create_by, gsr.create_time, gsr.update_by, gsr.update_time, gsr.del_flag, gsr.remark, gsr.is_auto, gsr.schedule_id, gss.SEND_PERSON, trt.RECIPE_TYPE_NAME, tmi.MACHINE_NAME from t_glue_span_receive gsr LEFT JOIN T_GLUE_SPAN_SEND gss ON gsr.SEND_ID = gss.ID AND gss.DEL_FLAG = '0' left join t_recipe_type trt on gsr.recipe_type = trt.recipe_type_code and trt.del_flag = 0 left join (select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_mix_machine where del_flag = 0 union select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_lhfl_machine where del_flag = 0) tmi on gsr.machine_code = tmi.machine_code and gsr.entrusted_mix_area = tmi.mix_area where gsr.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND gsr.ID = #{id}
mapper.update:
merge into t_glue_span_receive a USING (
select #{item.id,jdbcType=DOUBLE} id, #{item.receiveQty, jdbcType=DOUBLE} receive_qty, #{item.machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR } machine_code, #{item.recipeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR } recipe_type, #{item.recipeVersionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR } recipe_version_id, #{item.recipeStage,jdbcType=VARCHAR } recipe_stage, #{item.receiveStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR } receive_status, #{item.receiveTime, jdbcType=DATE} receive_time, #{item.receivePerson,jdbcType=VARCHAR } receive_person, #{item.source,jdbcType=VARCHAR } source, #{item.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR } update_by, #{item.updateTime, jdbcType=DATE} update_time, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR } remark from dual
) b ON ( a.id = b.id AND a.del_flag = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE
a.receive_qty = b.receive_qty, a.machine_code = b.machine_code, a.recipe_type = b.recipe_type, a.recipe_version_id = b.recipe_version_id, a.recipe_stage = b.recipe_stage, a.receive_status = b.receive_status, a.receive_time = b.receive_time, a.receive_person = b.receive_person, a.source = b.source, a.update_by = b.update_by, a.update_time = b.update_time, a.remark = b.remark
